questions.question: Explain the characteristics of research report.
questions.solution_html:
• A research report presents findings in a systematic and structured manner. It includes
  • methodology, analysis, and conclusions based on evidence.

questions.question: Explain the practical problems faced during fieldwork.
questions.solution_html:
• Fieldwork often faces issues such as access, bias, and ethical challenges. Time,
  • resources, and respondent cooperation also affect data collection.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: resources, and respondent cooperation also affect data collection.

questions.question: Analyse the main ideas of empiricism in research.
questions.solution_html:
• Empiricism emphasizes knowledge based on observation and experience. It forms the
  • foundation of scientific research.

questions.question: Evaluate the importance of proper referencing.
questions.solution_html:
• Proper referencing ensures academic credibility and transparency. It also helps avoid
  • plagiarism and acknowledges sources.

questions.question: Write down the difference of questionnaire and interview schedule.
questions.solution_html:
• A questionnaire is self-administered, whereas an interview schedule is conducted by
  • the researcher. They differ in flexibility, interaction, and depth of responses.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: the researcher. They differ in flexibility, interaction, and depth of responses.
